title: GamesAnnouncement
description: games.announcement@1: what a mod announces through games.world.announce on OpenVibe.Games. Not an HTTP route: the mod runtime binding ModApi.announce(text) (apps/server/src/mods/runtime.ts), driven by the announcements section of the mod's games-content@1 pack (validated strictly: text 1-200 characters, repeated every everySeconds, 60 to 86400). The text is whitespace-collapsed and cut to 200 characters; an empty one is dropped.
